citation.authors: Jillella A, Keerthi N, Venkateswar Reddy J

cited_by.title: Ashwagandha: cortisol, mood, skin, hair, heart, kidneys and liver

record.population: Adults aged 18 to 60 with hair loss or skin conditions (number not stated in the abstract), one clinic in Hyderabad, India
record.design: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, 300 mg standardised root extract twice a day for 75 days
record.finding: Greater improvement than placebo in transepidermal water loss (skin barrier), in hair density, growth and anagen:telogen ratio, and in skin and hair quality-of-life scores. No adverse events. The extract was supplied by the manufacturer, Ixoreal Biomed.
record.note: One clinic, manufacturer-supplied product, sample size not in the abstract. Ethnicity and hair type not stated, so nothing is known about afro-textured hair or skin of colour.
